measurement_scope: Historical sequence87 plus v15 material, sizing only; v16 final material must be measured before allocation.

what_this_proposal_changes.why: The Linux successor controller closes at 142 distinct ordered source references, nine above the approved 133. Two causes, neither optional. The port itself added five paths over the window11 predecessor (HostProvisioning.json, build-linux-manifest.mjs, check-digest-pins.mjs, selftest-runtime-pins.mjs, read-source-blobs-linux.mjs), taking 132 to 137; the last of those is live code that source-publication.mjs imports, so the set cannot be trimmed back under 133 by deletion. Four further files were then added because they are read at runtime by path and were absent from the manifest: skills/clued/SKILL.md and its two references, whose bytes were previously checked only inside prepare() -- that is, after the GA is issued and the budget reserved, so a drifted Skill byte would have burned the single allocation -- and apps/clued-cloud/package.json.
what_this_proposal_changes.why_160_and_not_142: Setting the ceiling at exactly what is needed today means the next file added by any fix re-crosses it and this whole re-issue repeats. 160 leaves 18 of headroom, about twelve per cent, and does not change the batch shape: 128 refs per batch means 142 and 160 are both two batches, and 160 refs consume roughly 7.3 per cent of the encoding limit. 257 would force a third batch and a further set of bounds to argue, so the headroom is deliberately kept below that.

precedent.note: source_refs_maximum inside capacity_delta is the established supplemental layer, not a scope cap. It has been raised under this same mechanism before: 128, then 130, then 131, then 133, each with an Owner approval and an independent applicability. This is the fifth use of the sanctioned path.
precedent.corrects_an_earlier_mischaracterisation: An earlier draft by the implementing side described this raise as a second instance of the excluded "cap extension" clause, alongside the forward cap. The successor independent reviewer rejected that reading and the rejection is accepted: the excluded clause governs the root3 appendix's own scope caps, and reading it to cover capacity_delta would retroactively invalidate the 128, 130 and 131 raises and with them the 4,000,000-byte original input limit this run depends on.
precedent.forward_cap_is_a_different_case: qualificationLimits.forwards 16 is a controller constant, not part of capacity_delta, and carries no document backing. It is NOT covered by this proposal and remains an open item.
precedent.this_raise_is_larger_than_its_predecesso: The four prior raises moved the ceiling by one or two. This moves it by twenty-seven, of which nine are needed today and eighteen are headroom. The size is stated plainly rather than split into smaller raises, because splitting would obscure that the underlying cause is a host migration rather than incremental growth.

necessity: The Windows qualification host was lost permanently on 2026-09-12 and the controller was ported to Linux. The ported controller has been over the approved source-reference ceiling since its first commit -- 134 at 755d744 -- which no revert can undo, because the paths that carry it over are the port itself. Without this supplement no valid GA can be constructed for the Linux controller and the qualification cannot proceed at all.
drafted_by: implementing side; requires Owner approval before any effect
